parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` reflects two distinct test scenarios for the same API-version defaulting behaviour — one covering the absence of any override or flag, the other covering an explicit V1 feature-flag value. Collapsing them would obscure the separate failure modes each test is designed to catch. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record has `is_test: true` warrants no-action.
